title: The Busy Bakery
text: Every morning, the bakery on Elm Street gets busy before the sun comes up. Bakers mix flour, sugar, and eggs to make bread and cakes. The ovens bake loaves of bread until they turn golden brown. Workers frost cupcakes and fill trays with cookies. By seven o'clock, the shelves are full of fresh treats. The little bakery works hard every day to feed the whole town.
